attributes.name: patcher
attributes.digest: Patcher reference
attributes.description: The word, followed by a symbol describing a valid path to a patcher, sets the patcher referenced by theobject. The default is the special symbol, which represents the patcher the pattrhub object resides within. Theobject can refer to patchers other than the one in which the object resides. A double-colon syntax ('::') is used to separate levels of patcher hierarchy. See thehelp file for further information on this feature.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: Incoming messages to theobject are analyzed. If the first element of thematches the name of a- or-maintained object, the subsequent arguments in the message set that object's value. If the first element of the message matches(name), where (name) matches the name of a- or-maintained object, the value of that object is sent from theobject's right outlet, preceded by the object's name. Otherwise, the message is passed through theobject and output from its left outlet.

messages.name: getstate
messages.description: Themessage causes a series of lists to be output from theobject's right outlet -- one for every- or-maintained object in the patcher containing theobject. Each list begins with the name of the object, and is followed by the object's current value.
